{{Top}}
[[File:EmperorsArrival-RotJAVA.png|200px|thumb|Emperor Palpatine wore zeyd-cloth robes.]]

'''Zeyd-cloth''' was a type of dark-[[Color/Legends|colored]], non glossy fabric that had square waffle styled weaves. It was in use since at least the [[Galactic War]], during which it was turned into various items of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]], including robes, tunics, [[Boot/Legends|boots]], gloves, and headgears.<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Later in history, members of the [[Order of the Sith Lords|Banite Sith]] would often wear black hooded robes made of zeyd-cloth. Such individual included [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]].<ref name="SW:DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> Even after the latter toppled the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and established the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> he continued wearing those simple garments as the [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Galactic Emperor]].<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref> The Emperor's [[Inquisitorius/Legends|Inquisitors]] would also don dark maroon robes of zeyd-cloth that were designed to invoke images of dark [[Blood/Legends|blood]].<ref name="l1">''[[The Last of the Jedi: The Desperate Mission]]''</ref> While the Sith garments made of zeyd-cloth were plain-looking, expensive tailored suits could be made out of that same fabric. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Tuyay]], Chief Operating Officer for [[Ororo Transportation/Legends|Ororo Transportation]], was known to wear one such suit.<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>
